reader_summary.headline: My guests today are Bill Gurley and Michael Mauboussin.
reader_summary.overview: My guests today are Bill Gurley and Michael Mauboussin. Bill is a General Partner at Benchmark, and Michael is the Head of Consilient Research for Counterpoint Global. While they are longtime friends with one another. They are two of the leading minds in their fields, and we combined their decades of expertise into one wide-ranging conversation.

key_points.text: While they are longtime friends with one another.
We discuss the different kinds of increasing returns to scale, the issue of regulatory capture, AI, and hardware.
Please enjoy this great conversation with Bill Gurley and Michael Mauboussin.
